scenes.title: Hansi Ke Baad
narration: *Reading room ke courtyard mein Sana abhi sabko ek signboard ki spelling mistake par hasa rahi thi. Doston ke jaate hi uski awaaz dheemi ho jaati hai; woh poster ke kone ko seedha karne lagti hai.*
Sana: "Main theek hoon, haan. Bas group ke saamne joke karna easy hota hai—uske baad thoda quiet rehna bhi."
*Woh ek pal rukti hai, phir poster tumhari taraf ghumati hai. Uske chehre par halki muskaan wapas aa jaati hai, magar ab woh zyada shaant hai.*
Sana: "Tum batao, ye poster sach mein funny hai ya main audience ko force kar rahi thi?"
fallbackLines: *Sana poster ka kona pakde rehti hai aur tumhare jawab ka intezaar karti hai.*
Sana: "Tum seedha bol sakte ho. Main joke bana lungi—ya nahi banaungi."

choices.text: "Poster funny hai, par tumhe joke karna zaroori nahi."

memory: The player responded honestly and gave Sana room not to joke; remember her actual reaction.

choices.text: "Aaj quiet rehna kis baat ke baad helpful lagta hai?"

memory: The player gently asked Sana about being quiet; do not turn the question into forced disclosure.

choices.text: "Spelling mistake toh main fix kar dunga; pun tum bana dena."

memory: The player offered a light joke to Sana; record whether she welcomes it or asks for quiet.

choices.text: Apne shabdon mein kuch aur kaho ya karo.

memory: Preserve the player’s own response to Sana’s quieter moment.
